newsitem.title: RUSSIA: SIDANKO to appeal Purneftegaz ruling.
newsitem.headline: SIDANKO to appeal Purneftegaz ruling.

text.p: Russian oil group NK SIDANKO will appeal a Moscow court ruling denying it control over production company Purneftegaz, a SIDANKO spokesman said on Friday.

"The company management will continue to assert its interests in legal form and will appeal to the Supreme Arbitration Court against the decision of the federal arbitration court of the Moscow region," the spokesman said.
The Moscow court on Thursday held that state-owned oil company NK Rosneft would maintain control of the production unit.
Different arms of the Russian government have awarded Purneftegaz to both SIDANKO and Rosneft at different times during reorganisation of the Russian oil industry.
A Rosneft spokesman said the Supreme Arbitration Court appeal would be SIDANKO's last resort in the battle for Purneftegaz, which has been dragging out for over a year.
OAO Sibirsko-Dalnevostochnaya Neftyanaya Kompaniya (SIDANKO) is one of Russia's largest vertically integrated oil groups.
Its main production units include Chernogorneft, Kondpetroleum and Varyoganneftegaz.
At dispute is a 38 percent stake in OAO Purneftegaz, which covers 51 percent of its voting shares.
Shares in Purneftegaz had not traded by 1020 GMT on Friday. They fell after news of the court case results on Thursday, closing at $3.51 after $3.70 at Wednesday's close.
